description:
Location: Kansas City, MO – Local Pickup highly preferred (Willing to drive up to 50 miles to meet/deliver; weekdays are perfectly fine). With serious buyers, I’ll be happy to FaceTime so you can see everything on video.
Description:
Up for sale is a meticulously maintained, exceptionally clean Profitec Pro 300 (made in Milan, Italy) dual-boiler PID espresso machine with olive wood upgrades, paired with a beautiful curated set of premium olive wood and walnut accessories. Total original MSRP value for this setup is $2,561.84. I am parting with the entire bundle for $1,450 for a straightforward, local pickup deal.
I have owned the machine for just over 1.5 years, and it was very lightly and carefully used, and meticulously maintained on schedule, for just 1 year before being systematically cleaned, fully drained, and properly prepped for storage/transport. Functionality is excellent and work flow is simple and efficient. This was a gift for my girlfriend and ultimately, she doesn’t need the elevated coffee experience.
Water, Maintenance & Performance History:
Water Diet: Fed exclusively with water filtered through the Aquagear Water Filtration System. This has kept the dual boilers perfectly clean, scale-free, and well-maintained.
Cleaning: Meticulously backflushed on a strict schedule using chemical backflush detergent (Cafiza).
Performance: Pump and flow rate have been tested regularly as part of my maintenance schedule. The group head consistently clocks a flow rate that is better than factory specifications, indicating zero internal restrictions, a perfectly clear gicleur, and a robust pump.
What’s Included in the Bundle:
Profitec Pro 300 Espresso Machine: Dual boilers, PID temperature control, integrated shot timer, and olive wood upgrade accents (knobs and portafilter handles).
Original Accessories: Includes original single and double-spouted portafilters, stock baskets, blind basket, cleaning brush, and an open container of Cafiza detergent. Original box with manual.
Wiedemann Olive Wood WDT Tool & Stand: High-end German-engineered puck distribution tool with a matching weighted olive wood base (both made in Germany). On the WDT tool, the needles are in perfect condition, with 2 spare ones included.
Wiedemann Dosing Funnel: Precision-milled metal funnel for seamless, zero-spill grinding, 58 mm silver, with secure magnetic connection.
Breville The Force Gauge Tamper: 58 mm, made of premium stainless steel, with an American walnut handle to provide a perfectly level, calibrated, and consistent pressure, adjustable from 7 kg-10 kg.
Condition:
Cosmetically and mechanically excellent. Minor, inevitable light swirl marks on the polished stainless steel drip tray from routine gentle cleaning and light use, but otherwise flawless. It functions exactly like a brand-new machine.
Terms:
Local pickup highly preferred. Will consider shipping for motivated buyers. I am located in the Kansas City, MO area and am happy to meet a serious buyer up to 50 miles away. Weekday meetings are perfectly fine. Cash, Zelle, or Venmo accepted. Please comment on this thread before sending a PM or chat.

title: Guernsey milk cow in milk
description:
Selling a Guernsey cow, currently in milk, in her 2nd lactation. A2A2 and disease-free.
We purchased her from a dairy in Lamoni, IA on October 5, 2022 at two weeks old and raised her on a bottle. Trained to a halter from birth and walked daily, she is extremely easy to handle, calm, and gentle. I can approach her anywhere in the pasture, hook her up, and walk her like a well-trained dog.
Stanchion trained and hand milked, twice a day, producing approximately 4-5 gallons per day. We have always calf shared so we don’t know the exact volume she produces. She does not kick or shuffle her feet while milking, though she does better if she has the anticipation of some feed as a treat at some point during milking.
She is definitely the boss of the pasture, can be pushy for food and steal from others bowls if left alone, but as long as one of us is out there, she behaves.
Trained to single strand electric for rotational grazing.
She was bred by AI to a Dexter bull and gave birth to a bull calf on November 25, 2024.
She was then bred by a registered Dexter bull, with a service date of June 18, 2025. She gave birth to a heifer calf on March 30, 2026.
She currently has a blind quarter. Her first lactation, all four quarters were great. After calving for a second time, one of her front teats would not fill up properly and stopped producing, but she is good in the remaining 3.
Located in Kansas City, MO
Asking 2 and a half.
**Not currently confirmed bred but was bred to an Angus bull via AI on 09-20-2026
ai_notes: [Guernsey dairy cow] The cow has a blind quarter, which is a permanent condition but does not prevent milking. Valuation is based on the seller's asking price.

title: Reborn Baby Doll
description:
$398 firm. Local only.
I created this sweet reborn doll using the newly released Frankie kit by Mayra Garza. Not a factory painted doll. These types of dolls are hand painted completely then assembled, again, by hand. The head and full limbs are made of soft vinyl that are weighted with fine glass beads then attached to a cloth body that has been stuffed with soft polyfil fiber and steel bb pellets are placed in a small sack and placed in the body surrounded by polyfil to give baby a nice realistic weight and feel. The head is weighted to fall forward just like a real newborn so it must be supported when picking baby up.
Newborn size 19 inches and 5lbs. I used Genesis Heat Set paints. The eyes are poly glass in beautiful Natural Blue. Given veining, blushing and mottling. Strong earth magnet in the mouth to hold the magnetic pacifier. Can send home as either gender. Full limbs. Painted and sealed light brown hair. Nails are tipped and sealed.
You can visit my nursery on Barb's Baby Dolls on reborns.com for a look at all my previous babies.

description:
I am selling this collection of UNUSED U.S. commemorative postage stamp blocks and strips.
These stamps range in face value from 2¢ to 22¢.  They are all in very good unused condition.  See the series of 7 pictures included for details.
These are all unused U.S. postage stamps and CAN be used for valid postage, but I am selling these mainly for those who may still be collecting stamps and still need to fill in some gaps in their collection.
Therefore, the selling price for these stamps would be 3 times their face value.  (Example:  a 22¢ stamp would sell for 66¢, making that block of 4 = $2.64.)
They can be purchased selectively in groupings of your choice (if still available).  However, I will not break apart the existing blocks or strips to sell individual stamps and I do encourage a minimum purchase of $5.00.
If you are interested in purchasing the entire group that remains, we can negotiate a better price, but offers less than twice the face value will not be considered.
NOTE:  These stamps have been previously mounted in an album, so some of the stamps have indications on the backside of being affixed.  They all still have their original glue.
I will not be updating the pictures as stamps sell, so if you are interested in any of these stamps, feel free to contact me.  Be sure to indicate which stamps you are interested in and I will  let you know if they still exist.
I am located north of the river and will publicly meet in the Northland for your purchase of the stamps, but I will also consider mailing the stamps to someone who pays for them in advance (including the necessary postage costs to send).

title: Perfect for RV park or storage facility
description:
28,000 sq ft building on 15 acres with a well and highway frontage. Presently utilized for large flea market.
Pindall is the only town in the United States with that name. And if you sneeze you’ll miss the town completely.
Despite its size of less than 100, it’s located conveniently to every landing along America’s unimpeded first National River, the Buffalo.
Known for its high peaks. crystal clear waters, high mountain trails and clean camping facilities all along the river’s stretch.
There’s not anything outdoors that cannot be found to do unless you’re the one that needs a nightclub occasionally.
But if that’s the case, you’re not more than 55 miles or an hour drive to Branson Missouri.
Pindall Arkansas is located in the northwestern corner of Searcy County. It’s positioned halfway between Marshall Arkansas in Searcy County and Harrison Arkansas in Boone County. Which all rest along US Highway 65.
Pindall will also be less than 35 miles to the New Bass Pro Conservation facility being built on the old Dogpatch amusement park in the only county in Arkansas that is known for not ever having a railroad, Newton County.
And if casinos are your game, there are several within an hours drive.
Buffalo National River has nearly 36,000 acres of designated Wilderness within its boundaries.
The Lower Buffalo Wilderness Unit adjoins the USFS Leatherwood Wilderness Area that has 16,956 acres.
The combined 39,456 acres of the Lower Buffalo and Leatherwood Wilderness Areas creates the largest area of designated wilderness in the Ozark-Ouachita Highlands. This area is also unique regionally in providing multi-day river trips all within a wilderness setting.
There have been recorded 55 species of mammals, 250 species of birds, and 59 species of fish, along with a multitude of reptiles, amphibians, insects and other invertebrates throughout the area.
Everything from Bald Eagles, elk, black bear and an occasional cougar have been spotted as well.
When it comes to the Buffalo, The National Park Service states in its publication “Currents” that the Buffalo National River is viewed as a Class I river, which is generally accepted as the least difficult river rating. However, it can move into the Class II rating in times of high water.
The Boston Mountains is a Level III ecoregion designated by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) in the U.S. states of Arkansas and Oklahoma.

title: Vintage Koch Commercial Butcher Block Countertop Section
description:
A very rare find and piece of Kansas City history.  A near new section of unused hard maple commercial butcher block counter top that is at least 63 years old.  Measures 42 1/2” long, 18” wide and 2” thick. The maple strips are both glued and bolted together, making it suitable for daily use in a commercial environment. Would make a great conversation piece inside your home or used in the prep area of an outdoor kitchen. The “K.C 8 MO” stamp branded in the edge indicates it was made before 1963 when the modern 5-digit ZIP code system introduced.  Koch was a major manufacturer of butcher shop equipment, and based here in the Kansas City area.
No shipping on this item. The buyer will need to pick up in the east Independence area.

I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.

I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure. These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that. description:

One matched set of 1982 Chevrolet Cavalier OEM GM ignition and door/hatch keys with knockouts. These were the original set of keys that were never used on the car and were not found when the car was traded in. There are two (2) GM ignition keys (and 1 copy) and two (2) GM door/hatch keys (and 1 copy). Aftermarket color-coded keys had been cut and used for simple visual identification. Also included is a key fob from the original selling dealership, Classen-Morse Chevrolet, originally in Midtown, K.C. MO and later moved to 9201 Metcalf in Overland Park, KS.
Knockout Codes for keys were the following:
28F9
27M7
Asking $40.00 cash only please for entire key set pictured (the 2 copies are not in the pics. They were found after the pics were taken). No warranty, implied or otherwise, on keys. Items sold as/is. These keys would be a goldmine for someone with a survivor or restored vehicle with a worn set of keys or aftermarket replacements. Research I have found states that for a 1982 model the primary (square) key (also known as a B46) should have a J stamped at the base of the key shaft and the secondary (round) key (also known as a B47) should have a K stamped at the base of the key shaft. These keys may also fit other year Cavalier ignition and door locks or other GM vehicles. Please verify your vehicle requirements prior to purchasing these items.

KitchenAid Professional 600 series bowl-lift stand mixer, model KP26M1XPM in Pearl Metallic. 6 quart stainless steel bowl with handle, 575 watt motor, 10 speeds, all-metal drive. Comes with the flat beater, wire whip, spiral dough hook, and 2 flex-edge scraper beaters.
Size and weight: about 16.5 in tall x 11.3 in wide x 14.6 in deep, and about 28 lbs with the bowl and attachments — a heavy, solid machine. Check your under-cabinet clearance, it needs about 17 inches.
Works great — in great working condition.
Honest wear: the finish on the base has worn, blotchy spots (see the front photo — what you see is what you get) and the bowl has light scratches inside from normal use. Purely cosmetic.
Great for serious home bakers: bread dough, pizza dough, sourdough, cookie dough, cake batter, mashed potatoes, whipped cream and frosting. The 6 qt bowl handles big batches — up to 13 dozen cookies or 8 loaves of bread at once — and the bowl-lift design stays put with heavy dough. Perfect for holiday baking, a home bakery or cottage food business, farmers market baking, or as a wedding or Christmas gift for a baker. The power hub also fits KitchenAid attachments like a pasta maker, meat grinder and ice cream maker (attachments sold separately, not included).
These were $549.99 new.
Local pickup in Kansas City, MO 64118, door pickup.

title: 2004 Fleetwood Prowler For Sale
description:
2004 Fleetwood Prowler fifth wheel – approximately 30 ft. Selling because our family is moving to Australia.
We are the second owner, purchased in 2015. It has been the best family purchase so far and we have made many memories in "The Spirit of Adventure." I have priced to sell rather than store it.
We used the camper this summer and I would personally feel comfortable towing it across the country right now. It has been a dependable family camper and has been maintained rather than sitting neglected.
The tires are approximately 4 years old, and the wheel bearings were serviced last year. We also re-coated the roof with three heavy duty coats of rubber sealant this past Spring. Registration is current and valid through September 2027. ALL of the appliances (oven, gas range, microwave, refrigerator), water heater, AC, and heater work, and the camper is ready to use. There are 2 medium sized propane tanks (one on each side).
The interior is in good condition for its age, with a front bedroom, kitchen/living area, one master slide-out, bathroom/shower, and plenty of storage. It has been well cared for and presents much better inside than many campers of this age.
I want to be upfront about the condition. The camper has had previous water damage that was repaired, and the roof was redone last year. We made the repairs ourselves because most professionals repair the cosmetics, while we went for heavy duty function with some overkill. There are some normal cosmetic signs of age. The slide could use servicing, and the awning does need replacement. You can use it, and we did this past summer.  These items are reflected in the price.
This is not a new camper and I'm not trying to price it like one. It's an older, solid fifth wheel that we've continued to use and maintain. It would make a good inexpensive family camper, hunting camper, lake camper, or seasonal setup for someone who doesn't want to spend $20K+.
$5,750 OBO. Clean title, in hand.
We're preparing for an overseas move, so I am motivated to sell to a serious buyer. Reasonable offers considered, but I'm not interested in trades.

title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

title: Purebred White Sebastopol Geese • Rare Curly Feathers
description:
Beautiful purebred white Sebastopol geese looking for new homes! 🪿
All 6 hatched in February 2026 and are now about 8 months old. Their signature Sebastopol curls are really starting to come in, and they’ll continue getting fluffier and more dramatic as they mature.
Sebastopols are a rare heritage breed known for their long, soft, curling feathers, beautiful blue eyes, naturally yellow “eyeliner,” and orange-pink bills. They’re basically fancy feather boas with opinions. 😂
The photos are of our actual birds and adult birds from our flock so you can see what their mature feathering looks like.
About them:
• Purebred white Sebastopol geese
• Hatched February 2026
• Healthy and outdoor raised
• Accustomed to living with other geese
• Beautiful blue eyes
• Curly feathering developing nicely
• Young enough to settle into a new flock before spring breeding season
Sebastopols are seasonal breeders, with most breeding and laying happening in spring and early summer. Females generally begin laying during their first full spring and can also make attentive broody mothers.
These are not typical feed-store geese. Sebastopols are an uncommon heritage breed, and quality mature birds and breeding pairs can sell for considerably more.
Located in Kansas City, Missouri.
$200 each
$1,000 for all 6
Reasonable offers considered, especially if taking multiple birds. I’d love to see them go in pairs or groups rather than individually when possible.
Please message me with how many you’re interested in and a little about where they’ll be living.

title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. title: NEW PRIMEWELD CT520DP 50A Pilot Arc Plasma Cutter
description:
Never hooked up or used. New stand, gloves, pliers, original packaging, and helmet included. Paid $700 with tax. Majority of a 3 year warranty included. Prime is excellent in customer service. 5.0 star rated.
FIRM CASH PRICE.
The PrimeWeld CT520DP 50A Pilot Arc Plasma Cutter Combo is a 3-in-1 triple threat featuring TIG welding, stick welding, and a plasma cutter. This pilot arc plasma cutter and TIG/stick welder cuts and welds 1/2-inch thick steel plate. You’ll be able to cut parts quickly and easily. Switch to TIG welding by changing leads and flipping a switch. If you don’t feel like the challenge or cost of shielding gas, you have a stick arc welding on tap as well.
Affordable Versatility in a Compact Package
At the other end, this pilot arc welder gets down to 10 amps on all three processes, low enough heat to work on 24-gauge sheet metal. It’s a great machine for auto bodywork, with the ability to cut damage out, prepare replacement panels, tack them into place and then weld the seams to a beautiful finish. Preparation for paint goes much faster, lowering the costs of body repair work.
The CT-520DP offers dual-voltage input power, with the ability to run on either 120 volt or 240-volt outlets. These 3 in 1 plasma cutters with welding functions are what you need to bring versatile fabrication to your workbench. Every barn shop and racing trailer has a place for the PrimeWeld CT-520DP multi-process welder.
High-Frequency Arc Starts and Advanced Design
The pilot arc plasma cutter features high-frequency no-touch arc starts. Start your plasma cutter by simply pulling the trigger and starting the arc. Most 3 in 1 plasma cutters don’t offer no-touch arc starting or arc force control. PrimeWeld's pilot arc welder offers an ideal mix of features for under $500.
With PrimeWeld’s optional foot pedal, control the current for TIG welding and plasma cutting. The PrimeWeld CT520DP Pilot Arc Plasma Cutter and Welder is ruggedly built from the ground up to stay alive in the workshop environment.
No-Hassle 3-YEAR Warranty
Enjoy PrimeWeld’s Legendary Support
PrimeWeld Customer Support connects you real PEOPLE, real quick. We’re easy to contact and will strive to handle any issue that comes up.
Offering excellent and knowledgeable advice, they know how to keep PrimeWeld equipment up and welding right.

title: MINT 1985 Kansas City Royals 5-Piece World Series Print Archive
description:
Offered from a private local collection: a complete, museum-grade 5-piece print archive from the 1985 Kansas City Royals World Series championship.
This is not a collection of yellowed, folded attic papers. Every piece in this set has been preserved in clean, unread, flawless condition for over 40 years. It tells the complete story of the 1985 title—from the pre-series preview to the Game 7 victory celebrations.
What Is Included in This 5-Piece Collection:
Sports Illustrated (Nov. 4, 1985) - "A Royal Crown" (2 COPIES): Two separate, pristine copies of the famous championship issue. Both are rare NEWSSTAND EDITIONS with no subscriber mailing labels printed on the covers. Perfect for having one copy on display while keeping the second stored or submitted for grading.
Sports Illustrated (Oct. 28, 1985) - "The World Series / Ozzie Smith": The official World Series Preview issue printed right before Game 1. Also an unprinted newsstand copy with razor-sharp edges and bright cover inks.
The Kansas City Star (Oct. 28, 1985) - "World Champions!": The iconic morning-after newspaper wrap. Features clean white pages, zero sun fading, and no dark fold creases across the headline. Includes all original 1985 local ads inside.
The Squire’s Other Paper (Oct. 31, 1985) - "Free At Last!": An ultra-rare local Kansas City suburban newspaper printed right after Game 7. Because this publisher went out of print years ago, surviving copies in this unread condition are almost impossible to find anywhere on the market today.
Why This Set Is Unique:
Buying these items individually in this condition requires months of searching and multiple shipping fees. This listing offers a complete, pre-curated 1985 time capsule ready for custom framing, a home sports room, or an executive office display. Would make a unique gift for a Royal's fan.
Condition Notes:
Please inspect the close-up photos. The paper is bright, the spine edges are sharp, and the pages are unread. You are buying high-grade, investment-quality paper.

Ruck Plates are compact and fit seamlessly in the Rucker and Ruck Plate Carrier for superior stability. Made in the USA to exacting standards of quality and craftsmanship, GORUCK Ruck Plates represent the very best of American manufacturing.
Break strength of approximately 90,000 lbs
Powder coated matte black (rust resistant)

30LB (Standard) Dimensions: 9" x 11.5" x 1.38"
30LB (Long) Dimensions: 9.5" x 15" x 0.94"
45LB Dimensions: 9.5" x 15" x 1.38"
Made in the USA (except 10lbs)
Rucksack Compatibility
Our standard of compatibility is that Ruck Plates will be stable and secure in your Ruck with minimal shifting.
If you have a Ruck Plate Carrier, we recommend the shorter (Standard) Ruck Plates -  10LB, 20LB or 30LB.
The 20L and 25L Rucker feature an additional pocket to securely fit a 45LB Ruck Plate, which can be paired with a 20LB or 30LB Ruck Plate for up to 75 lbs of total weight.
If you have a GR1, we recommend the Standard Ruck Plate -  30LB.
45LB Ruck Plates only strap in securely to the 20L/25L Rucker and Long Ruck Plate Carrier, however they will fit into the interior elastic pocket of the GR1 (suitable for upright weighted rucking, but not ruck PT aka burpees and bear crawls).
WHEN IN DOUBT
Start With 20#
The relationship between your body, the weight, and the rucksack will determine your level of comfort on the move. Our recommendation for most people is to start with 20 lbs of weight for rucking, progress in increments of ~10 lbs, and ultimately max out at 1/3 of your bodyweight. It’s more important to keep proper form while rucking than to have more weight.

title: Kidde liquid fire suppression for restraunte hood
description:
There is 5 4 gallon buckets and 4 2.66 gallon boxes the manufacture date is 6/26 so there fresh and all are factory sealed
• What it is: A specialized potassium carbonate-based wet chemical solution.
• Primary Use: Specifically formulated for commercial kitchen fire suppression systems to control Class K high-temperature cooking oil and grease fires.
• How it works: When discharged through the hood system, the liquid solution knocks down the flames, provides rapid thermal cooling, and reacts with hot grease through a process called saponification. This turns the grease into a soap-like foam blanket that blocks oxygen and prevents dangerous flash re-ignition.
• System Safety Notice: As clearly marked on the label, this liquid charge is meant exclusively for engineered fixed pipe kitchen systems and must not be used to fill portable fire extinguishers.
Chemical Properties & Hazard Profile
• Main Ingredients: Typically consists of a precision-blended solution of greater than 40% Potassium Carbonate (CAS # 584-08-7) mixed with water.
• Safety Considerations: According to the manufacturer’s Safety Data Sheets (SDS), the alkaline nature of this chemical solution makes it an irritant to the eyes, skin, and respiratory system upon direct contact. Protective eyewear and gloves should always be worn during system maintenance or cleanup.

title: 1999 Ducati 996S for sale
description:
1999 Ducati 996S,  No 015, From Ducati MS forum; "An authentic plaque reading "Ducati 996S  015" confirms that the bike is an early, highly sought-after 1999 Ducati 996 S. Standard 996 S as completely unnumbered applied mostly to the subsequent 2000–2001 mass-production versions. The 1999 model year was a unique exception in Ducati history. When Ducati first introduced the "S" trim to specific markets (primarily the United States) in 1999, it wasn't just a mid-tier catalog option,  it was treated as a semi-exclusive introductory variant. To mark this introductory launch, Ducati outfitted the 1999 models with a sequentially numbered, riveted metal badge directly on the top triple clamp. Because this plaque shows 015, this bike was one of the earliest off the Borgo Panigale production line for that specific introductory configuration.   "Open-Ended" Series: Unlike true limited editions (which usually display an "X / 500" format), these early 1999 996 S plaques only displayed the sequence number itself. Ducati kept the total production open-ended to gauge market demand before expanding the line into normal mass production for the 2000 and 2001 model years when the plaques were dropped."
Second owner, bought in 2008. 17,000 miles, but replaced speedo shows 12,900. All body work and tank have been repainted and clear coated, 1000 and 2000 wet sanded. S model includes Marchesini wheels, Olin rear shock and steering stabilizer, up graded Showa front forks. Less then 20 miles on new Pirelli diablo tires, front 120/70, rear 180/55, new battery, new timing belts and oil change, starter motor. red suede mono seat, also have dual seat and subframe with passenger footpegs.Gold anodized sprocket and chain covers, Pazzo front brake and clutch levers. Moto-Science turn signal rear view mirrors, carbon fiber chain guard/tire hugger, exhaust wrapped, new fuel pump, double bubble wind screen. No cracks in the body work or fastener holes. Have original mirrors, windscreen, covers, pit stands, repairable body work and spare tank, etc. Ducati owners manual and Haynes shop manual. Clean title. Accept reasonable offers. Prefer paypal cashier check and buyer arranges pickup. call 816 223 7416

The rear door is a wide 85"x85" ramp, plus there's a gull-wing door on the roadside and a 30"x68" side door on the curbside. Electrical includes 110V and multiple LED lights inside and out. Some extras are 1000 lb loose D-rings, skid pads, stone guard, and a heavy-duty tongue jack.
The trailer carries limited lifetime structural and 5-year axle warranties, plus a tire and rim warranty package. It’s designed as a bumper pull with a 2-5/16" coupler and includes stabilizer jacks. Overall, it’s a sturdy trailer built with aluminum rims and a solid frame, suited for hauling ATVs and UTVs enclosed.

ENGINEERING

The brain of the DCT, Advanced Transmission Logic, senses how you drive and adapts. Relaxed drivers get earlier shifts for a quieter ride at lower engine speeds. Sportier drivers will hold each gear longer for higher RPM shifts. And when going downhill, you get true engine braking. Now that’s a smart transmission.

Using the same Unicam® cylinder head design found in our motocross bikes, it’s more compact in size, and it still delivers the kind of horsepower and torque you’d expect from a flagship model.
- 2000-POUND TOWING CAPACITY
Call it 2000 pounds, or call it 1 ton. Either way, the towing capacity of the Pioneer 1000-3 is unsurpassed by any competitor. So instead of hopping on the tractor or taking out the truck, you can stay right in your side-by-side and tackle those bigger jobs with relative ease.
HANDLING

Prepare to go further than ever before. - Front Tires 27 x 9-14
- Rear Tires 27 x 11-14
- ELECTRIC POWER STEERING
Honda Electric Power Steering system helps eliminate bump steer through rocky and rutted terrain, which reduces fatigue. What makes it even better is the added assist you get when you need it most, like when you’re in 4WD, driving at lower speeds, or maneuvering over rough conditions.
- PADDLE SHIFTING
Steering column-mounted paddle shifters add a serious dose of performance in every drive. In Manual mode, they let you shift without ever taking your hands off the wheel, and in Automatic mode, they let you override the current gear with a quick up or downshift, holding that gear for several seconds before returning to Automatic mode.
- TURF/2WD/4WD/DIFF LOCK
Don’t tear up sensitive surfaces. Select Turf Mode. Want to access as much traction as possible? Put it in 4WD. Need maximum power at all four wheels? Lock the front and rear differentials. And the best part is, you can do it all with a shift of a single lever.
VERSATILITY
- 1000-POUND-CAPACITY TILT BED
There are a ton of reasons to buy a Pioneer 1000-3. Among them: the half-ton hauling capacity*. No side-by-side can haul more, and when it comes to dumping, we’ve made it easier than ever, with a hydraulic assist tilt bed lever that can be accessed from outside the vehicle, or right from the driver’s seat.
COMFORT

Tough, durable and built to enhance every driving experience — yes, we’re talking about the seat. Contoured for three passengers, the center seat is positioned up and forward to maximize space and comfort, and the covering is designed to resist both the elements and heavy use.
- LCD DISPLAY
The multi-function LCD dash display is large enough to host loads of information, in an easy-to-read way, like speed and fuel level. RPM and transmission mode. Fuel gauge, water temperature, trip information and more. It even includes a clock, so you’ll always know when it’s time for some fun.
- SOPHISTICATED CHASSIS
Some of the most impressive Pioneer 1000-3 features are those you’ll never see. In addition to the suspension and ground clearance, we rubber-mounted the engine and exhaust system to insulate the cabin against excessive vibration. So while you may not see this feature, it’s one you will definitely notice.
- TILT WHEEL
With a tilt steering wheel, you’re ensured an even more comfortable driving experience. We’ve given the wheel a wide range of adjustments for optimum customization, and it even moves very far forward to allow for easy entry and exit.
SAFETY
- DRIVER/PASSENGER PROTECTION
The Occupant Protection Structure uses large-diameter tubing, and meets OSHA’s rollover protection standard. The hard doors and roll-up side nets help keep debris from entering the cabin, and auto-style three-point seatbelts are equipped with an emergency locking retractor mechanism, to help optimize passenger security. When you put this much safety first, fun is sure to follow.
- FOUR-WHEEL DISC BRAKES
The Pioneer’s uncompromising power helps take you further than ever before. The reliable disc brakes help you stop on a dime. Built to the same standard as you’d find in our autos, the four-wheel disc brakes minimize debris from building up, ensuring consistent performance, and giving you confidence on the trail.

title: Nigerian Dwarf Goats (Does)
description:
Looking for a sweet, lovely dairy goat doe to cheer your homestead and provide the most delicious milk you have ever tasted?  These girls are looking for YOU!!
I'm a milk testing herd through Purdue University, and I have milk records on hand for their mothers/grandmothers. We breed for excellent quality, super sweet, and creamy milk; ideal for homesteads wanting a top-quality dairy source. I included a picture of our milk showing the natural cream line. As you can see, Nigerians naturally have very creamy milk, but we have gone the extra mile to select for EXTRA deliciousness. Not only that, but we have also been selecting for a couple of generations now for superior illness resistance and easy birthing.
Prices range from $500-$1000 per goat, though we offer discounts on family sets (for example, a mother/daughter duo or two sisters).
~My herd is tested and completely free from CL, CAE, and Johne's disease.
~Registerable with ADGA and AGS.
~I have raised my goats holistically for nearly a decade, and I am glad to teach what methods of natural care I have found most successful if that interests you.
~Nigerians have the richest, sweetest, creamiest milk of any goat or cow breed. Take a look at the cream line in our goat milk (last picture)!
~Disbudded.
~Located in Hutchinson, KS.
I have about 45-60 Nigerians born at our farm every spring. I pretty much have does available year-round, including mature does that are either in milk or old enough to be bred to one of my awesome dairy bucks before leaving my farm. I will start having buck kids in March of 2027, so if you are looking for a phenomenal dairy buck to step up your breeding program with the does you already have, I can definitely help you with that as well. For folks who are just getting started, we are glad to teach and answer questions if you are eager to learn. We also welcome farm visits where we can answer your questions in person, demonstrate how we do things, and let you pick your future herd in person.
Edit: From October until February, ask us about having your doe bred to one of our awesome dairy bucks before she leaves our farm! For a small fee, this can get you some extra good genetics to work with, and if you’re just starting, it saves you from having to buy a buck right away. Our does average 2.8 kids apiece, depending on age.

title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

description:

This artwork from 1994, titled Painted Faces, features pueblo dancers from Northern New Mexico.
The medium:
"Hahn, who uses silk, begins by creating a sketch which she then transfers over to the fabric. She then applies hot wax to all the places on the silk that she wants to remain white. She then begins the process of adding a color of dye, then covering it with wax and continues this process until the entire fabric is covered in wax. The next step in the process is to crumple up the silk, creating cracks. After adding dye to fill in the cracks, the wax is removed with a hot iron."

title: Huge Lot of Home Brewing Equipment with Kegs
description:
I’m getting out of the home brewing hobby. I’ve made a lot of good beer with this set up overtime. It comes with everything you need to get brewing. There’s also plenty of wine making stuff as well.
Pick up in Kearney.
The racks of bottles are from Germany. They are all .5 L bottles most of them are from Germany, but some are import bottles as well.
The three kegs are 5 gal ball lock. Two of them have been converted from pin lock at some point.
The carboys are all 6.5 gallon glass with handles. The big mouth bubbler is the glass version, and it is really good for making wine in primary fermentation.
I used the set up doing brew in a bag (BIAB). However, you wouldn’t need much else to do full grain mash. I just don’t like cleaning a mash tun every time. If you’re doing extract kits, you’ve got way more than you need.
I’d prefer to sell all together.
More info:
Comprehensive home brewing kit includes multiple glass and plastic carboys, stainless steel Cornelius kegs, and a large stainless steel brew kettle. Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.

title: Osmo Little Genius
description:
The Osmo Little Genius Starter Kit is an interactive, hands-on educational learning system designed for children aged 3 to 5. It transforms an iPad or Amazon Fire tablet into an active preschool tool by combining tangible physical game pieces with digital gameplay.
How It Works
• The Base & Reflector: The tablet sits in a specialized Osmo Base, and a red reflector clips over the device’s camera. This allows the tablet to "see" and interact with what the child builds on the physical playmat in front of the screen.
• Active vs. Passive Play: Instead of just tapping glass, children manipulate real-world objects that come to life in animated stories and challenges narrated by a friendly monster named Mo.
• No WiFi Required: Once the companion apps are downloaded, the games do not need an active internet connection to run.

title: Onkyo A-RV400 amp
description:
Up for sale is a very nice Onkyo Stereo Amp, the A-RV400.  I just took this out of service two weeks ago when my new Yamaha came in. Amp runs perfect, is in excellent condition. The Onkyo A-RV400 is a classic, robust 100-watt-per-channel stereo integrated amplifier built in Japan during the late 1980s and early 1990s, highly regarded by budget audiophiles as a powerful vintage "workhorse."Audiophiles praise its clean, clear, and highly dynamic sound. Packing a true 100 watts per channel into 8 ohms, it offers serious power-per-dollar value and easily drives demanding floor standing or bookshelf speakers. A great feature is the dedicated Source Direct mode, which bypasses tone circuitry for a purer audio signal. It also features tactile front-panel sliders for Bass, Treble, and Balance, alongside a notable "Bass Select" loudness feature that provides deep, punchy low-end without sounding boomy.
Build Quality: Built during a golden era of Japanese stereo manufacturing, this amp has reliable, discrete output transistors and rugged internal build quality. Onkyo A-RV400 delivers classic high-fidelity performance with a versatile array of inputs. This integrated amplifier features a dedicated Phono stage for turntable enthusiasts, alongside Tuner, CD, and multiple Tape/VCR inputs. The Onkyo comes with a functional remote control.
Pickup evenings or weekends in Independence at QT Sterling and Truman Rd, or workdays in downtown KCK. If you see it listed it's available mister. Don't ask me "is this available?" or I will taunt you like a French Castle Guard.  Thanks for looking!

title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.

title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

PowerBlock U-90 Stage 1 premium adjustable dumbbell in excellent, fully functional condition. This is the highly sought-after Urethane Series, which features urethane-coated plates for much quieter workouts, smoother weight transitions, and superior durability against rust and chips compared to standard steel sets.
This is the Stage 1 base model, meaning it functions from 5 to 50 lbs on its own but is fully expandable up to 90 lbs if you purchase the Stage 2 and Stage 3 expansion kits later. It replaces a massive rack of traditional weights into a single, compact footprint.
Note: This listing is for one (1) single dumbbell, making it an ideal replacement piece, a heavy-duty addition to a kettlebell/cross-training setup, or the perfect find to complete a mismatched pair.
Specifications & Features
• Brand: PowerBlock
• Model: Urethane Series U-90 (Stage 1 Base)
• Current Weight Range: 5 lbs to 50 lbs
• Expandability: Fully compatible with U-90 Stage 2 (50–70 lbs) and Stage 3 (70–90 lbs) expansion kits
• Micro-Adjustments: 2.5 lb increments via internal chrome adder weights
• Plate Coating: Premium, impact-resistant matte black Urethane (non-marring)
• Grip & Comfort: Ergonomic textured handle with protective, padded wrist-support pillars
• Safety Mechanism: Auto-locking "Open / Closed" toggle switch to lock internal weights securely
Condition
• Mechanics: 10/10. The weight selector pin slides effortlessly into every color-coded rail. The internal adder weight lock clicks tightly and securely between Open and Closed positions.
• Cosmetics: 9/10. Very clean and exceptionally well-maintained. The color-coded weight charts on the side and top are fully intact, crisp, and easy to read. Minor cosmetic signs of light use on the block edges, but no deep scratches, cracks, or compromises to the urethane coating.
How to Use the Micro-Adjustments (2.5 lb increments):
The top color-coded chart shows your exact total weight based on how many internal chrome adder weights are nested inside the handle:
1. Empty Handle (5 lbs base): Gives you flat 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, and 50 lbs options.
2. 1 Adder Weight (+2.5 lbs / 7.5 lbs base): Gives you 12.5, 17.5, 22.5, 27.5, 32.5, 37.5, 42.5, and 47.5 lbs options.
3. 2 Adder Weights (+5 lbs / 10 lbs base): Gives you 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, and 50 lbs options.
To adjust: Flip the red tab to "OPEN", pull the handle out, slide the chrome cylinders in or out, reinsert the handle, and lock the tab back to "CLOSED".
